answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 72 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an anchor bet on surviving 72 epochs of grading, and every river settlement recomputes the fable schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
